reason: I travel twice a month and my bottle of magnesium always gets forgotten, so a sachet with the evening dose already counted out is handy. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy if a creator I like shows it.
objection: It's still two capsules every single day, and I'll probably forget by week two like every other supplement. Then I've paid for a box I won't finish, so the empty-box guarantee doesn't help me.
